notes: Paper presents first CMB-LSS cross-correlation constraints on dark photon kinetic mixing using Planck CMB data cross-correlated with unWISE galaxy survey. Main result: ε < 4×10^-8 (95% CL) over mass range 10^-13 eV ≲ m_A' ≲ 10^-11 eV, improving previous limits by ~order of magnitude. Data points extracted from Fig. 3 (exclusion plot) and text statements. The constraint is mass-dependent with strongest sensitivity at m_A' ≃ 5×10^-13 eV where ε < 2.08×10^-8. Three representative points chosen: lower mass bound, peak sensitivity, and upper mass bound. Signal detected via patchy dark screening (resonant photon-to-dark-photon conversion in large-scale structure). Extensive foreground removal (tSZ, CIB, radio) and validation tests performed.
